[[Sisters of Elune]] | quartermaster = {{RaceIcon|NightElf|Female}} [[Anisalah Starcaller]] | rewards = [[Saber]] mounts (rare and epic) | affiliation = [[Alliance]] | status = Active | tabard = Darnassus Tabard.jpg |caption=Icon of Wisdom}}'''Darnassus''' is the faction associated with [[Darnassus]], the capital city of the [[Night elf|night elves]]. The high priestess, [[Tyrande Whisperwind]], resides in the [[Temple of the Moon]], surrounded by other sisters of Elune. In the [[Cenarion Enclave]], the Arch Druid [[Fandral Staghelm]] leads the [[Cenarion Circle]], often in direct opposition to his fellow druids in [[Moonglade]] and Tyrande herself. ==Reputation== [[Raedon Duskstriker]] has the repeatable cloth quests to achieve a higher reputation with Darnassus. In return for exalted reputation, non-night elf players are able to ride [[saber]]s. The zones of [[Teldrassil]], [[Darkshore]], [[Ashenvale]], [[Stonetalon Mountains]], [[Feralas]] and [[Felwood]] offer many quests for gaining reputation with Darnassus. ==Rewards== At honored, [[Anisalah Starcaller]] offers a level 25 uncommon mail armor set. At revered, Anisalah Starcaller offers the [[Sentinel's Glaive]], a level 45 rare one-handed sword. At exalted, Anisalah Starcaller offers a tabard, and non-night elven Alliance races are able to purchase and ride Saber mounts (night elves can ride Darnassian sabers regardless of faction reputation). Darnassian sabers are bought from [[Lelanai]] at the [[Cenarion Enclave]] in Darnassus.
